Title: Login button does not respond after entering valid credentials
Preconditions: User exists and login page is accessible
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open login page 2. Enter valid email and password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: User should be redirected to the dashboard.
Actual Result: Nothing happens after clicking Login button.

Title: Error message remains after successful login attempt
Preconditions: User first attempts invalid login and then retries with valid credentials
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open login page 2. Enter invalid password and click Login 3. Enter valid password 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Previous error message should disappear after successful login.
Actual Result: User logs in, but the old 'Invalid credentials' message still appears briefly on screen.

Title: Forgot password link opens 404 page
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open login page 2. Click 'Forgot Password?' link
Expected Result: User should be redirected to the password recovery page.
Actual Result: System opens a 404 Page Not Found screen.
